AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  JULY 7, 2020
UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE
PROVISIONS OF THE GOVERNOR'S EXECUTIVE ORDER N-25-20, WHICH ALLOWS MEETINGS TO BE
CLOSED TO THE PUBLIC AND VIDEOCONFERENCED. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS DURING A MEETING,
EITHER SEND AN EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov OR DIAL INTO THE GOTOMEETING AT
(646) 749-3122, ACCESS CODE: 665-809-165 TO SPEAK ON AN ITEM OR UNDER ORAL
COMMUNICATIONS.  DETAILS  ARE  AVAILABLE  ON  THE  CITY'S  WEBPAGE  AT:
https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/meeting-agendas-393, which is also where the meeting may be viewed.
  6:00 PM
  VIDEOCONFERENCE
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Jennifer Perez, Mayor
  Tony Ayala, Vice Mayor
  Rick Ramirez, Councilmember
  Margarita L. Rios, Councilmember
  Ana Valencia, Councilmember
  Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, or through
  the video conference during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction
  subject to the rules of decorum described in Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three
  minutes.

  Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
  certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain
  matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.

  Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Council:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the City Council as a whole and not directed to individual Councilmembers.

  Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
  meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk's Department, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
  devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
  documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
  Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
  that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

  Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it
  has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

  Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
  during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
  telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

  STUDY SESSION MEETING – 5:00 p.m.
 CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Perez

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FOR CLOSED SESSION MATTERS

CLOSED SESSION

  I.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – EXISTING LITIGATION Government Code Section
  54956.9(d)(1): County of Los Angeles v. City of Norwalk, et al. Case No. 20STCP01480.

  II.  CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNCIL PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE §54957: THREAT
  TO PUBLIC SERVICES OR FACILITIES – Consultation with the City Manager, Los Angeles County
  Sheriff representative, and other related City officials.

  III.  CONFERENCE WITH REAL PROPERTY NEGOTIATOR PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE
  §54956.8: APN 8056-017-901; Negotiating Parties: Jesus M. Gomez, City Manager, on behalf of the
  City and Penny Reeves, Norwalk Auto Auction; Under Negotiation: Price and Terms of Payment.

RECESS

  REGULAR MEETING – 6:00 p.m.

CALL TO ORDER
  Mayor Perez

INVOCATION
  Rick Ramirez
  Councilmember

FLAG SALUTE
  Tony Ayala
  Vice Mayor

ROLL CALL
  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

CITY COUNCIL COMMENTS

  a.  Report of City Council Travel

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS
  City Council to proclaim July as National Park and Recreation / Parks Make Life Better Month in the City of
  Norwalk

CITY MANAGER COMMENTS
  COVID-19 Update.

CLOSED SESSION REPORT

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll call vote.
Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by City Council.

  1.  MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the meetings of June 16
  and June 24, 2020. 825-04
   Report

2.  PAYROLL – Staff recommends City Council approve the payroll for the periods May 17, 2020 –
  May 30, 2020 totaling $814,341.62 and May 31, 2020 – June 13, 2020 totaling $1,104,269.40. 630

  Report

3.  COMMERCIAL DEMANDS – Staff recommends City Council approve the warrant register period June
  11, 2020 - June 30, 2020, in the total amount of $4,512,218.72. 640

  Report

4.  CLAIMS AGAINST THE CITY – Staff recommends City Council deny the claims filed by Sandra
  Bautista and Jeremiah Summers. 830-02/19

  Report

5.  PLANNING COMMISSION SYNOPSIS – JUNE 10, 2020 - No action is required unless the City
  Council elects to review the decision of the Planning Commission on those items where the
  Commission’s action was final. 320

  Report

6.  RESOLUTION NO. 20-47 – APPROVING AGREEMENTS FOR THE NORWALK SENIOR NUTRITION
  PROGRAM FOR FISCAL YEAR 2020/2021 – Staff recommends City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 20-47, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK APPROVING AGREEMENTS WITH THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY WORKFORCE
  DEVELOPMENT, AGING COMMUNITY SERVICES AND BETTER 4 YOU MEALS CATERER
  FOR ELDERLY NUTRITION PROGRAM SERVICES FOR FISCAL YEAR 2020/21; and

  b.  approve agreements with:

  1.  the Los Angeles County Workforce Development, Aging Community Services to fund the
  Elderly Nutrition Program in the amount of $668,100 from July 1, 2020 through June 30, 2021;
  and

  2.  Better 4 You Meals Food Service from July 1, 2020 through June 30, 2021 in the amount of
  $520,740 to provide cooked meals for the nutrition program; and

  c.  authorize the City Manager to enter into the agreements and any amendments, provided there is
  funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in forms approved by the City Attorney.

  Report

7.  RESOLUTION NO. 20-51 – CHILD CARE SERVICES CONTRACTS – Staff recommends City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 20-51, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK APPROVING CHILD CARE CONTRACT AGREEMENTS WITH THE STATE
  DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION FOR FUNDING OF THE CalWORKs Stage 2, 3, AND
  ALTERNATIVE PAYMENT CHILD CARE DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM FOR FISCAL YEAR
  2020/2021; and

  b.  authorize the City Manager to execute the contracts and any amendments, provided there is
  funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in forms approved by the City Attorney.

  Report

8.  RESOLUTION NO. 20-52 – AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 ADOPTED BUDGET TO
  ACCEPT THE ENVIRONMENTAL ENHANCEMENT AND MITIGATION PROGRAM (EEMP) GRANT
  AWARD – Staff recommends City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 20-52, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 ADOPTED
   BUDGET TO APPROPRIATE FUNDS ACCEPTING AND ADDING THE ENVIRONMENTAL
  ENHANCEMENT AND MITIGATION PROGRAM (EEMP) GRANT AWARD, in the amount of
  $276,350 and a City match of funds in the amount of $13,000; and

  b.  authorize the City Manager to execute the contract and any amendments provided there is funding
  in the budget or documentation required by the grant, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by
  the City Attorney.

  Report

  9.  FISCAL YEAR 2020 CORONAVIRUS EMERGENCY SUPPLEMENTAL FUNDING (CESF)
  PROGRAM - Staff recommends City Council approve the agreement and accept the awarded
  Coronavirus Emergency Supplemental Funding program funds in the amount of $94,787, and allocate
  funds for the unforeseen expenditures as related to COVID-19.

  Report

  10. AMENDMENT NO. 7 – INTERSTATE-5 CONSORTIUM CITIES JOINT POWERS AUTHORITY
  AGREEMENT - Staff recommends City Council approve Amendment No. 7 to the I-5 Consortium Cities
  Joint Powers Authority Agreement. 1015-02-01

  Report

  11. PROJECT NO. 7513 – CITYWIDE SEWER MANHOLE REPAIR & REPLACEMENT PROJECT -
  ACCEPTANCE OF WORK – Staff recommends City Council accept the construction work of Sancon
  Technologies, Inc., in the amount of $44,135 for Project No. 7513, citywide sewer manholes repair
  project.

  Report

APPOINTMENTS

  12. ADVISORY BODIES – Staff recommends City Council make appointments to fill vacancies for two-year
  terms ending March 31, 2022.. 200

  Report

PUBLIC HEARINGS

  13. ADOPTION OF A NEGATIVE DECLARATION; RESOLUTION NO. 12-48 ADOPTING STREET
  VACATION NO. 88; RESOLUTION NO. 20-49 ADOPTING GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT NO. 182;
  ORDINANCE NO. 20-1717 ADOPTING ZONE CHANGE NO. 361; RESOLUTION NO. 20-50
  ADOPTING SIGN USE PERMIT NO. 315; ORDINANCE NO. 20-1718 ADOPTING A DEVELOPMENT
  AGREEMENT – FIRESTONE BOULEVARD CUL-DE-SAC SOUTH OF ROSECRANS AVENUE - Staff
  recommends City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 20-48, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK APPROVING STREET VACATION NO. 88;

  b.  adopt Resolution No. 20-49, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK APPROVING GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT NO. 182 AND ADOPTION OF THE
  NEGATIVE DECLARATION;

  c.  introduce for first reading, Ordinance No. 20-1717, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF NORWALK
  SETTING FORTH ITS FINDINGS OF FACT AND DECISION APPROVING ZONE CHANGE NO.
  361, by title only and waive further reading;

  d.  adopt Resolution No. 20-50, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK APPROVING SIGN USE PERMIT NO. 315;

  e.  introduce for first reading, Ordinance No. 20-1718, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK, APPROVING A DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY OF NORWALK
  AND EVERGREEN MEDIA LLC APPROVING A NEW DIGITAL BILLBOARD SIGN ON
  FIRESTONE BOULEVARD SOUTH OF ROSECRANS AVENUE ADJACENT TO THE I-5
   FREEWAY, by title only and waive further reading; and

  f.  authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement, and any amendments, on behalf of the City,
  on a form approved by the City Attorney.

  Report

PUBLIC HEARING CONTINUED FROM JUNE 16, 2020

  14. RESOLUTION NO. 20-43 - ESTABLISHMENT AND/OR ADJUSTMENT OF FEES AND SERVICE
  CHARGES FOR FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 – Staff recommends City Council adopt Resolution No. 20-43,
  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK APPROVING
  ADJUSTMENTS TO THE COMPREHENSIVE FEE SCHEDULE FOR CITY SERVICES FOR THE
  2020/21 FISCAL YEAR.

  Report

REPORTS

  15. CORONAVIRUS PANDEMIC - EMERGENCY OPERATIONS CENTER – Receive and file.

  Report

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT

I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated July 2, 2020.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk
